proposed_facts.reason: Canonical source saves root scale into entry.x8 and passes its address to efAsync_Spawn. Accessory initialization is conditional, whereas callback installation, effect queuing, audio and color-animation calls are unconditional. Accepted deferral of async interpretation and retention.

The exact interpolation, unconditional root scaling and alternate entity-0 dereference match source. Entry_Anim decrements the replacement timer; EntryStart_Anim decrements before testing zero. The proposal correctly avoids guaranteed sampled endpoints or exceptional-number recovery.

EntryEnd initialization uses x6C0, while physics divides by x6BC and does not decrement the timer. The alternate branch only follows entity 0. Separate zero-result animation dispatch supports the endpoint and scheduling qualifications.

Local collision-box selection and GA_Air dispatch match source. Independently inspected helpers show the air suppression guard, grounded failure callback and synchronous invocation without event-pointer retention.

contradictions.reason: Accept all six section-fact deferrals: source-level helper calls and numeric literals establish neither compiled .sdata/.sdata2 membership nor section purpose, alignment or pool loads.
Accept the remaining-jump-availability deferral: ftCommon_8007D5D4 writes jumpsUsed=1, but that assignment alone does not establish an available jump for every fighter and action consumer.

Accept the dual-entity fact and character-specific link deferrals. Both accessory callbacks coordinate logical entities, and Player_GetEntityAtIndex uses transformed[index]. Its Ice Climbers comment does not establish exclusive character mapping or x221F_b4 producers.

Accept all trophy-animation and on-screen-appearance identity deferrals, including the EntryStart setup, countdown, physics, EntryEnd handoff, accessory upkeep and empty IASA claims. Presentation operations and trophy_scale use are visible, but exact asset identity is not proved by these routines or rendered names.

Accept supersession of the effect-position characterization: entry.x8 is populated from root scale. The replacement preserves the outgoing pointer without claiming its unexamined asynchronous interpretation.

Accept both interpolation supersessions and the related retraction deferral. Unchecked ratios, distinct x6BC/x6C0 roles and decrement/transition ordering do not guarantee exact reversal, settling or sampled zero/one progress. Root scaling also occurs in the alternate EntryStart branch.
Accept the signed-countdown deferral: the field is canonically bool timer. Its arithmetic use does not independently establish the underlying typedef, signed width or compiled overflow behavior.
Accept the collision supersession: successful air collision is insufficient when ft_80081A00 suppresses the callback. The grounded helper instead invokes its callback on collision-test failure.
Accept the empty-physics-hook deferral: an empty callback establishes no local work, not immunity from engine-wide updates.
